jobs.title: Corporate Communications Program Manager
jobs.description:
Become part of the excitement.

As a Corporate Communications Program Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing effective communication programs for public relations, social media and internal communications. You will build awareness, credibility and visibility for Graybar while protecting the Company’s reputation.

In this job you will:
- Develop and manage internal and external communication programs that reach target audiences using a diverse mix of communication tactics.
- Coordinate day-to-day management of media relations and social media activities that align with overall strategy and business goals.
- Oversee internal communication programs that support Graybar’s strategy.
- Create content to drive greater awareness around specific messages, themes or issues, or further engagement with specific audiences
- Increase visibility of the Company’s executives and subject matter experts (SMEs) through speaking and editorial opportunities.
- Manage participation in relevant industry awards programs.
- Participate in development of a crisis response plan; manage media during crisis.
- Research and recommend new technologies and channels that may enhance company communications.

What you bring to the table:
- 5 years experience required
- 6+ years experience in  communications, specifically within public relations and internal communications preferred
- 4 year degree in communications, journalism, business and/or liberal arts preferred
- Understanding of media needs and relationships
- General industry knowledge, as well as knowledge of key industry influencers
- Knowledge of internal communications and organizational change management principles
- Familiarity with social media management and measurement tools
- Message and story development skills
- Excellent oral and written communication skills
- Good analytical and problem solving skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, exercise good judgment, and deal with confidential information
- Detail oriented, thorough, and accurate
- Creative and innovative
- Ability to build relationships
- Some travel required

Compensation Details: The expected starting rate of pay for this position is $75,000 annually depending on experience. This position is also incentive eligible, based on specific and relevant business metrics.

jobs.title: Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
Become part of the excitement.

As a  Manager - Financial Planning & Analysis, you will support and assist in advancing the Company’s strategic plans by providing insightful business analyses, financial impact estimates, and forecasts of existing trends in business processes, resource investments, and business units to evaluate progress toward long range goals and make recommendations for achieving those goals.

In this role you will:
- Prepare financial and business related research and analysis on existing processes, markets, and business units
- Analyze current and past trends in key performance indicators including all areas of revenue, cost of sales, expenses and resource investments
- Monitor performance indicators, highlighting trends and analyzing causes of unexpected variance
- Develop sophisticated modeling to forecast business trends.
- Assist with special financial and business related studies and cooperate with other departments in preparing analyses
- Compile and prepare reports, graphs and charts of research results
- Provide market intelligence, evaluate local markets, analyze current and potential financial metrics, and make recommendations
- Analyze, determine and recommend staffing levels for various markets
- Responsible for end-of-year budgets for the Income Statement

What you bring to the table:
- 5 years experience in data research, financial analysis, and forecasting
- 4 year degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or related discipline
- Advanced mathematical and analytical skills
- Excellent oral and written communication skills
- Advanced problem solving skills
- Ability to analyze various data, model complex scenarios, and forecast trends
- Ability to think creatively and evaluate multiple analytic methods
- Ability to effectively articulate and present research results to others
- Ability to persuade and influence others
- Ability to work independently and objectively
- Ability to achieve highest standards of accuracy and precision
- Ability to manage time and research projects effectively
- Occasional to frequent travel required

jobs.title: Treasury Analyst
jobs.description:
Make a difference.

As a Treasury Analyst, you will perform detailed analysis and provide specialized reporting to senior management that will optimize financial planning and decision making.

In this role you will:
- Prepare and develop various non-recurring and recurring reports and forecasting models as assigned by the Assistant Treasurer, Vice President and Treasurer, or Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.
- Provide the Vice President and Treasurer with various specialized monthly, quarterly, and annual reports on the performance of the Company's accounts receivable portfolio.
- Perform analysis on financial decision-making opportunities such as rate of return, lease verses buy, capital budgeting, and lease internal rate of return.
- Responsible for preparation of the quarterly report that is presented to the Company's Finance Committee; audit final reports for accuracy and ensure deadlines are met.
- Recommend, develop, and maintain models that forecast the future financial performance of the Company.
- Provide independent valuations of acquisition candidates.
- Provide backup to other Treasury functions

What you bring to the table:
- Minimum 3 years of experience:  Must have excellent skills in spreadsheet and forecast computing including Excel, Visual Basic, and Access and demonstrated ability to understand and apply basic financial concepts
- 4+ years of experience preferred
- Four-year degree: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, or a closely related discipline; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.
- Knowledge of financial practices and techniques
- Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques and how to apply them to the Company's proprietary models
- Understanding of how to apply basic to moderately complex financial concepts
- Ability to analyze and draw conclusions from large volumes of data
- Ability to perform a wide variety of moderately complex treasury activities
- Excellent skills in Excel
- Strong oral and written communication skills
- Ability to work under limited supervision and exercise good judgment
- Some travel required

Compensation Details: The expected starting rate of pay for this position is $67,919 annually, depending on experience. This position is also incentive eligible, based on specific and relevant business metrics.

jobs.title: Vice President Sales Enablement
jobs.description:
Make a difference.

The Vice President Sales Enablement will lead the Company's sales enablement strategy by establishing the processes, tools, training, analytics, and governance that improve sales effectiveness and execution. They will partner with sales leadership, DVPs, HR, IT, Marketing, and other corporate functions to create a consistent sales operating model, strengthen accountability, and support profitable growth across all markets.

In this role you will:

- Establish and maintain the Company's sales and sales management processes.
- Define standard sales practices, account planning expectations, pipeline management disciplines, and opportunity management processes.
- Partner with sales leadership to establish performance expectations.
- Partner with IT and AI/Data teams to improve sales tools, automation, and reporting.
- Lead the enterprise sales training strategy and governance model.
- Partner with HR and sales leadership to develop onboarding, role-based training, leadership development, and ongoing learning programs for sales employees.
- Partner with sales leadership and HR to define sales competencies and performance expectations.
- Develop reporting that improve visibility into sales effectiveness and execution.
- Support succession planning and development efforts for sales leadership roles.
- Lead processes to gather and analyze customer feedback and field insights.
- Ensure customer needs and market trends are incorporated into sales training, account planning, and commercial strategy.
- Communicate actionable customer and market insights to sales leadership.
- Serve as the primary Corporate Sales liaison to the Directors of Sales.
- Lead enterprise initiatives that improve sales execution, commercial effectiveness, and customer engagement.

What you bring to the table:

- 10 years' experience in sales leadership, sales operations, sales enablement, commercial operations, or related leadership roles
- Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives and organizational change
- Experience implementing sales processes, technology platforms, training programs, or performance management systems
- Four-year degree

Preferred

- Experience with Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms

jobs.description:

As a Product Category Manager, you will be responsible for driving, supporting, and providing assistance in the category strategy business plan implementation and execution across the organization.   Lead the strategic development of product-specific category plans, identify new growth opportunity category initiatives, and provide robust analytics for category platform.

- Direct and manage the Product Management team with dedicated team members aligned with product-specific categories
- Define supplier strategy to improve market share and profitability; develop and maintain relationships with suppliers and functional business managers
- Oversee the product line lifecycle for driving growth from strategic planning to tactical execution
- Direct and lead the Product Management team to ensure that product-specific category development plans are aligned with overall strategies to drive profitable growth of the category
- Collaborate with field sales leadership to ensure that business development plans for the category are aligned with regional growth and profitability goals
- Establish, maintain and provide knowledge of assigned product category through national sales tracking and reporting, product category insights and market trends
- Develop, implement and evaluate product category marketing strategies
- Facilitate the periodic evaluation of supplier performance
- Identify and execute appropriate action plans for improvement when results are below expectations with assigned suppliers
- Initiate and negotiate distributor and incentive agreements with suppliers that provide protection and profitability for the Company

- Excellent communication and business presentation skills

jobs.title: Compensation Manager
jobs.description:
Become part of the excitement.

As the Compensation Manager, you will own the design, governance, and administration of the compensation policies, plans, and procedures, ensuring compensation decisions consistently reflect the Company's philosophy, support business goals, and maintain market competitiveness, internal equity, and compliance.

In this role you will:
- Manage compensation plan practices, policies, processes, and system data to support accuracy, integrity, consistency, and compliance.
- Oversee the design, implementation, administration, and evaluation of compensation programs and recommend changes to ensure alignment with Company objectives and compensation philosophy.
- Develop and lead compensation analyses, workforce models, and recommendations that support compensation strategy, program design, business objectives, and Compensation Committee decision-making.
- Serve as the organization's primary compensation expert, overseeing compensation structures, incentives, commissions, job evaluation, and pay practices while ensuring consistent application of the Company's compensation philosophy, internal equity, market competitiveness, and compliance requirements.
- Prepare materials for Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors, including summaries of current program design, market positioning, business considerations, and proposed changes.
- Review and analyze merit increase proposals, promotional increases, market adjustments, and related recommendations to ensure consistency with market data, budget parameters, and the Company’s compensation philosophy.
- Review executive compensation data and partner with Legal to finalize reporting for the Compensation Discussion and Analysis section of the annual Information Statement.
- Establish and maintain routine audits of compensation policies, practices, plan eligibility, and system data, and provide relevant summaries, metrics, and recommendations to management.
- Oversee the development of manager tools, training resources, educational materials, and process documentation related to pay practices, salary ranges, job descriptions, incentive plans, and management responsibilities.
- Oversee participation in, submission of, and analysis of salary surveys and recommend updates to compensation policies, structures, and practices as appropriate.

What you bring to the table:
- Minimum of 8 years of progressive Human Resources or compensation experience, including a solid understanding of compensation theory, plan design, market analysis, job evaluation, and compensation administration
- Four-year degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field
- Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) preferred
- Experience supporting Compensation Committee or Board-level materials preferred
- Experience developing compensation models, salary structures, incentive plans, and pay governance frameworks preferred
- Knowledge of compensation-related government compliance and regulations
- Knowledge of compensation plan structure and design principles
- Knowledge of quantitative analysis, financial modeling, and data interpretation techniques
- Knowledge of HR systems, compensation systems, and Microsoft Office applications, with strong proficiency in Excel
- Leadership and supervisory skills
- Excellent oral and written communication skills
- Collaboration, influencing, advisory, and stakeholder management skills
- Mathematical, statistical, and compensation modeling skills
- Analytical, problem-solving, and decision-support skills
- Strong organizational, prioritization, and project management skills
- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple, competing priorities
- Ability to work cooperatively with others

Compensation Details: T he expected starting rate of pay for this position is $105,978 annually, depending on experience. This position is also incentive eligible, based on specific and relevant business metrics.

As a Manager – Lighting Business Development, you will manage the Company's lighting product and service programs. Our ideal candidate will have Electrical distribution, lighting, project, or contractor sales experience .

In this role you will:

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Travel & Operations Analyst (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
Are you ready?

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized professional to provide vital support to our operations by managing travel reporting, maintaining structured data hierarchies, and delivering accurate administrative services.
In this role, you will act as a key resource for the organization by executing standard data entry, generating compliance travel reports, managing system hierarchies, and taking ownership of updating, maintaining, and publishing internal policies, procedures, and forms.

(Note: This position is aligned with the company’s Data Analyst II job profile for classification purposes. The role focuses on data entry, system maintenance, and operational reporting rather than statistical data analysis or metric evaluation) .

In this role you will:

- System & Configuration Support: Review Concur Expense and Travel configuration setups for operational flow, monitor and coordinate with IT on the Concur error log for updates, and provide direct employee system support.
- Travel Operations & Reporting: Generate standard travel reports and book reservations using the Sabre Red Travel System.
- Data Verification: Review travel reports and operational entries for correctness and data integrity, executing necessary corrections.
- Documentation Management: Update, maintain, and publish internal policies, procedures, and operational forms for company-wide use.
- Hierarchy Maintenance: Maintain organized files, records, and structured system hierarchies.
- Daily Administration: Leverage Microsoft Office applications and SharePoint for daily tasks, record-keeping, and data management.
- Deadline Management: Manage multiple operational priorities effectively to meet strict publishing and reporting deadlines.

What you bring to the table:

- Education: High school diploma or GED required.
- Experience: Minimum of 1 year of professional administrative experience required (2–3 years preferred, specifically with Microsoft Office and the Sabre Red Travel System).

- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook)
- Familiarity with SharePoint and document repositories
- Working knowledge of Sabre Red Travel System and Concur Travel & Expense System
- Strong numerical accuracy and basic mathematical skills for data entry
- Exceptional organizational and file-management skills
- Solid computer literacy and system navigation skills
- Clear communication skills with meticulous attention to detail
- Ability to maintain high accuracy and data entry precision under deadlines
- Ability to manage multiple administrative tasks simultaneously
- Ability to execute accurate travel bookings in the Sabre Red Travel System
- Ability to troubleshoot and resolve routine system errors

Shift and Hours: 4 hours per day; Monday to Friday

Compensation Details: The expected starting rate of pay for this position is $20.00 per hour, with compensation subject to increase based on experience.
